verdict.rationale: Better Auth's organization plugin advertises assigning "roles and permissions" and "access control" within multi-tenant orgs and teams. The admin plugin manages user roles. This suggests a permission layer slightly beyond bare roles, but nothing in the evidence shows resource-level, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based (ABAC) authorization. Missing for 10: documented resource-level permission checks, relationship- or policy-based authorization model, custom permission/statement definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
